results.rationale: This is a forward-delivery solution requirement, and while we have related network design/cybersecurity deployments, the provided evidence does not explicitly demonstrate SCADA/IoT remote monitoring with a centralized multi-site web dashboard.

This is a verifiable technical capability requirement, and neither the company profile nor the cited capability records show grid interconnection studies or protection coordination expertise (only bridge engineering examples are provided).

This is a mandatory delivery compliance requirement, and our solar energy deployment experience supports credible commitment to execute electrical works in accordance with IEC 62548 and the Pakistan Electricity Code.

This is a verifiable staffing/licensing requirement, and while we have 4 PE-registered engineers in-house, the evidence does not confirm the specific licenses/roles required by the RFP clause for installation teams.
This is a forward-delivery O&M obligation and is directly supported by our stated support model of 24–48h response SLAs and quarterly preventive maintenance offerings.

This is a verifiable HSE policy plus safe-execution track-record requirement, and we have a documented HSE policy along with multiple hospital IT deployments indicating experience working in operational healthcare environments.
This is a forward-delivery training/knowledge-transfer obligation and is credible based on our hospital IT implementation experience where structured training is typically part of delivery.
Procedural/evaluation rule — complied with in the submission (we will ensure the bid targets meeting the 70-mark technical threshold).
